practices.rule: 4 design decisions before code: purpose/tone/constraints/differentiator
practices.why: prevents generic AI aesthetics; intentionality drives quality

practices.rule: no Inter/Roboto/Arial — pick distinctive display font
practices.why: avoid generic look; typography is foundation of personality

practices.rule: color dominance: 60-70% primary + 1-2 sharp accents
practices.why: cohesion > equal distribution; timid palettes look generic

practices.rule: animate only transform+opacity (GPU), avoid width/height/top/left
practices.why: layout thrash causes jank; GPU properties skip layout step

practices.rule: use stagger(80-120ms) for card lists, not simultaneous entry
practices.why: UX rhythm; simultaneous = jarring, stagger = natural flow

practices.rule: page load timeline: nav(500ms) → hero-title(800ms) → sub(-400ms) → cta(-300ms)
practices.why: visual hierarchy through timing; reader follows the sequence

practices.rule: react-force-graph-3d for >200 nodes (WebGL); react-force-graph-2d for ≤200
practices.why: WebGL handles scale; SVG/DOM breaks at 500+ nodes

practices.rule: node size = sqrt(backlinks)*2, min 2
practices.why: proportional visual hierarchy; sqrt prevents gigantic hubs

practices.rule: d3Force charge=-120, link distance=60, center=0.05 for Obsidian feel
practices.why: Obsidian defaults; balanced between tight cluster and spread

practices.rule: model links with semantic types (related/depends_on/blocks) and map each type to color/label
practices.why: typed edges increase graph readability and decision speed over unlabeled links

practices.rule: use a contextual mini-graph banner in header plus full graph on demand
practices.why: progressive disclosure preserves context without overwhelming the primary layout

practices.rule: Lenis duration=1.2 + expo easing for natural momentum
practices.why: matches physical expectation of paper/inertia

practices.rule: passive:true on all scroll event listeners
practices.why: non-passive blocks compositor thread; causes scroll jank on mobile

practices.rule: use R3F not raw Three.js for React projects
practices.why: declarative API = less boilerplate; auto cleanup on unmount

practices.rule: dpr=[1,1.5] in Canvas; frameloop=demand for static scenes
practices.why: limits battery/GPU on mobile; demand loop only renders when needed

practices.rule: interpolate with extrapolateRight:clamp to prevent overshoot
practices.why: unclamped interpolation continues past keyframe range

practices.rule: dynamic import with ssr:false for all editor components in Next.js
practices.why: editors use browser APIs (window/document) unavailable in SSR

practices.rule: Seesaw style: visual-first (60-80% viewport), max 3 colors, no UI framework
practices.why: editorial/portfolio sites need custom, not component-kit look

practices.rule: prefer HTML-first video composition workflows for agent generation and deterministic rendering
practices.why: agent-native HTML composition reduces prompt ambiguity and improves reproducibility

practices.rule: benefits not features; clarity over cleverness
practices.why: reader decides in 5 sec; features require understanding the product

practices.rule: CTA = [Action verb] + [What they get] + [Optional qualifier]
practices.why: proven conversion pattern; avoids vague CTAs

practices.rule: ask for referral AFTER aha moment, not at signup
practices.why: advocacy requires experienced value; early ask feels transactional

practices.rule: GEO: answer in H2/H3 as direct questions for AI citation
practices.why: Perplexity/ChatGPT cite direct Q&A format more than prose

practices.rule: double-sided referral incentive 2-3x better than single-sided
practices.why: both parties motivated; single-sided = free rider problem

practices.rule: social login reduces signup friction 40-60%
practices.why: email+password = 2-4 steps; OAuth = 1 click

practices.rule: LCP < 2.5s is hard SEO ranking factor
practices.why: Google Core Web Vitals directly impact ranking position

practices.rule: effective context = 60-70% of nominal window
practices.why: degradation starts earlier; 200K model degrades at 120-140K

practices.rule: critical instructions at start/end, never middle
practices.why: start/end=85-95% recall; middle=76-82% (lost-in-middle effect)

practices.rule: supervisor costs ~15x single-agent; max 5 workers before bottleneck
practices.why: token usage explains 80% of performance variance; justify each level

practices.rule: compress context at 70-80% utilization threshold
practices.why: avoid hard cutoff; proactive compaction better than reactive

practices.rule: 10 tools = 5K-8K tokens overhead pre-message
practices.why: tool serialization expands 2-3x; limit tools per agent role

practices.rule: use persistent file storage for state, not message-passing between agents
practices.why: telephone game: info degrades with each summarization hop

practices.rule: keep plugin manifests synchronized across runtimes (claude/codex/others) with automated validation
practices.why: manifest drift causes runtime-specific failures and broken releases

practices.rule: score external skills by maintenance, portability, specificity and safety before adoption
practices.why: reduces low-quality imports and keeps the skill pack stable over time

practices.rule: run closed-loop auto-improvement in dry-run first, then apply only after passing validation
practices.why: prevents unstable changes from being promoted into the baseline

practices.rule: for Tailwind blocks, keep max 3 dependencies and test responsive+a11y before merge
practices.why: prevents UI bloat and avoids regressions in production layouts
